title: What If You Tried to Swim in Titan's Methane Sea?
subject: Titan sea

scenes.text: What if you tried to swim in a sea on Saturn's moon Titan? It isn't water.
Titan's seas are liquid methane and ethane, at about minus 179 degrees Celsius.
The biggest, Kraken Mare, holds about 80 percent of the moon's surface liquid.
Cassini's radar found it at least 300 meters deep in its center.
Titan's air is mostly nitrogen, so there would be nothing here you could breathe.
Kraken Mare is almost as big as all five Great Lakes combined, and it's one of the only seas we know beyond Earth.
